body_html:
@chadsansig @hannahkane How does Planet Webmaker http://planet.webmakerprototypes.org/ work? I remember @toolness maintaining a spreadsheet. An RSS reader for clubs and professional development would be awesome.
Be cool if we had a spreadsheet to RSS feed. Kind of like how jstimeline3 works. You publish a GSheet template to the web, paste in code and get an RSS feed.

Are the guts to planetwebmaker on Git? Not that I would have any idea what to do.
